about_the_game:
This Downloadable Content Contains:

Captain's Glorious Summer Vacation outfit for Francis Drake

Change outfits by selecting the "Costumes" option in the "Customize Servant" menu in My Room.

Portraits change to reflect the outfit.

*There are some situations in the story where you will be unable to change outfits.
